content: {"rules": ["Forecast models consistently overestimate prices in early cycles, especially when sentiment is bullish.", "Sentiment spikes near the end of history often trigger a sharp price surge that models fail to capture.", "Models show mean-reversion bias in later cycles, underestimating sustained upward momentum.", "Forecast accuracy improves when sentiment aligns with historical price trends, particularly in mid-to-late cycles.", "Models exhibit lag in responding to sentiment shifts, especially when sentiment turns bearish mid-cycle.", "High sentiment volatility correlates with forecast overshoots, particularly in the first 10 days of the forecast window.", "Models underestimate price peaks during strong bullish sentiment, especially when sentiment is sustained over 3+ days.", "Forecast accuracy declines when sentiment is mixed or negative, especially in the final 5 days of the forecast window."]}
